description: navitok: session recorder (SessionStart/Stop/SessionEnd, silent), handoff resume (SessionStart: one summary line when .navitok/HANDOFF.md exists, not on resume) and schedule engine (UserPromptSubmit: recomputes .navitok/schedule.json, prints one line only when the fit status changes). Only in projects that have a .navitok/ folder. Output trimming (PostToolUse on Bash): off by default; when enabled in .navitok/config.json, replaces long Bash output with a trimmed copy and saves the full output to .navitok/logs/; silent otherwise.
